description: Assembles a single assembler file and writes the result in the chosen output format. The target system comes from --target (default c64). Without --cpu, the CPU of the target is used.

If the source contains .cartridge and --format is missing, the output is a cartridge (crt for the C64, car for the Atari, vic20cart for the VIC-20). Otherwise it is the default format of the target. Without -o, the output has the name of the source with the extension of the format. To build a whole project, use vcc build.

options.default_text: source name with the extension of the format

options.help: Target system: sets the CPU, chip symbols, text code and default format.
CPU instruction set, if it differs from the target.
Output format. d64, d71 and d81 put the program as the only file in a new disk image. a0, 20, 40 and 60 create a VIC-20 cartridge for the given memory block.
options.default_text: default format of the target system; a cartridge if the source has .cartridge

options.help: Memory expansion of the VIC-20. Sets the BASIC start, screen memory and color memory. No effect on other targets.
Cartridge type for crt, car and rom. Replaces the .cartridge setting in the source.
options.default_text: C64: normal; Atari: derived from the code

options.help: How to handle undocumented instructions: deny reports an error, warn a warning, allow nothing.
Extra search folder for include files. data/sys is always searched last.
Defines a constant for .if and .ifdef. Without =number the value is 1. Write numbers as 42, $2a, 0x2a or %101010.
Writes the labels as a VICE label file.
Writes the debug information (for the debugger and tests).
Writes the listing with addresses and bytes.
Folder of the hardware database (data). Replaces VC_DATA and the automatic search.

examples.title: MEGA65 program with a test constant
examples.cmd: vcc asm examples/mega65/prallball/prallball.asm -o prallball.prg --target mega65 --cpu 45gs02 --illegals deny -D START_HIRES=1

examples.title: Atari program as XEX
examples.cmd: vcc asm examples/atari/colorbars/colorbars.asm -o colorbars.xex --target atari8 --format xex

examples.title: C64 cartridge with several banks
examples.cmd: vcc asm examples/c64/cart_demo/cart_demo.asm -o cart_oc.crt --format crt --cart ocean -D OCEAN=1 --labels cart_oc.vs

notes: Any other value for --format creates a PRG file with that extension. --cart and --cpu are only checked during assembly and then report an error.
For cartridges, the assembler fills unused areas with $FF. The banks come from .bank and .org in the source.
A VIC-20 cartridge at $A000 needs the signature A0CBM at $A004 in the source.

exit.1: error in the source, while writing or in an option value
